blocks.text: One interpretive reading sees Matthew framing Jesus’ entry into Jerusalem, his actions in the temple, the healings and children’s cries, and the later question of authority through scriptural citations. In particular, the citation about a humble king riding on a donkey in verse 5 is part of the New Testament’s explicit reception of Zechariah’s portrayal of a humble king. This lens draws attention to Matthew’s use of Scripture as he narrates the chapter’s public conflicts and claims.
